name: Nahshon
overview: Nahshon, identified as the son of Amminadab, is prominently recognized in Scripture as a leader of the tribe of Judah. He served as captain of Judah's army, leading the camp and its armies, as noted in Numbers 2:3 and 10:14. Additionally, Nahshon is highlighted for his liberality, offering significant peace offerings on the first day, demonstrating both his leadership and devotion (Numbers 7:12, 7:17). His role underscores the importance of faithful leadership and generous worship within the community of Israel.
